validation.checks: Exact vc16 P bytes, mass, maximum and alpha; FP64 decoded-P tile-sum oracle; RNE boundaries and neighbours; masks and extreme fallback; current CUDA stream; benchmark checksums; API mode/domain gates; randomized full-API/core comparison and all-row error gates.

limitations: No complete Hopper attention execution locally. Helper tests do not replace the remote full-kernel check.
SM86 microbenchmark latencies are not H200 results; FP8 conversion implementations differ.
Independent component microbenchmarks are not additive or attention bottleneck percentages.
SASS equality normalizes the zero template parameter and excludes encodings/control bits.
No H200 speedup, 22 ms achievement or model-quality acceptance is claimed.
